summary: The Android notification initializer no longer refers to the absent ic_launcher drawable. It uses a dedicated monochrome drawable, and the release shrinker is instructed to retain that resource.

checks.name: Notification service regression tests
checks.observation: All 4 tests passed, including the case that maps Android invalid_icon PlatformException details to a bounded user-facing message.

checks.name: Source resource and initialization configuration
checks.observation: desktop/lib/src/services/native_notifications.dart initializes Android with ic_stat_notification; desktop/android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_stat_notification.xml defines it, and desktop/android/app/src/main/res/raw/keep.xml retains it through shrinking.

checks.name: Release resource packaging
checks.observation: The current signed release APK resource table contains the ic_stat_notification symbol. The same APK's Gradle release packaged_res output contains drawable/ic_stat_notification.xml and raw/keep.xml.

checks.name: Release artifact identity
checks.observation: SHA-256 is 5522767d06ec90f08f220bbb028abae9c1ec76ac57cb01a6bf9642cb046d749a, matching the recorded APK metadata.

checks.name: System notification delivery on the affected Samsung device
checks.observation: The release resource is present, but notification permission grant/denial and background delivery still require runtime acceptance on the affected Android device.

remaining: Install this APK on the affected Samsung/Gboard device, open profile settings, enable notifications, and verify no invalid_icon PlatformException appears and a generic notification is delivered while the app is hidden.
